tiers.focus: Suez corridor, Port Said, Alexandria, Suez
tiers.learning_objective: Students learn that geography is not passive — it is the substrate of commerce. The canal binds three continents.
tiers.witness_requirement: Every port visit requires two witnesses

tiers.learning_objective: Students learn that contracts are not paper — they are testimony. The witness-log proves economic reality.

tiers.name_en: Governance — The Law of the Sea
tiers.learning_objective: Students learn that maritime law is the substrate of peace between nations. Contest is the legitimate tool for resolving disputes.
